questions.title: Learn more about male pattern hair loss
questions.text: Find out what causes it, and which treatments may help slow it down or help hair grow back.

text:
Exit consultation
What causes hair loss?

Male pattern hair loss is caused by a combination of genetics and sensitivity to DHT (dihydrotestosterone), a hormone made from testosterone.

In people who are susceptible, DHT gradually causes affected hair follicles to shrink and shortens the hair growth phase. New hairs become finer and shorter and may eventually stop growing in some areas of the scalp.

Treatments can help slow further hair loss and may support regrowth. Options include finasteride and minoxidil, which work in different ways.

How does finasteride work?

Finasteride reduces DHT by blocking an enzyme that converts testosterone into DHT.

Lowering DHT can slow the shrinking of affected hair follicles. When taken consistently, finasteride can slow hair loss and may support regrowth in some men.

How does minoxidil work?

Minoxidil increases blood flow and nutrients to hair roots.

Used regularly, it can help hair grow back thicker over time. It usually takes a few months to notice a difference.

Some men use finasteride and minoxidil together. Complete your assessment to find out what's right for you.
